lines.say: Every job in your city went to robots. Except yours.
You're the last human cashier in the city. You feel lucky.
Then the queue starts. Hundreds of people. Every day.
Nobody buys anything. They just stand there. And film you.
Then you see the sign outside. Last Living Worker. Forty dollars a ticket.
You get paid ten. Would you keep the job? Write it in the comments.
